name: peak_age
purpose: inferred peak age: +4 equals +3 while +1 lies in +2 .. +2+3

name: rating
purpose: the country's rating (1771:10E7) + 0x7F at creation, the player's ceiling

name: ability
purpose: current ability, +3 reduced by the distance of +1 from +2 .. +2+3

name: position
purpose: the position code (0 the goalkeeper); the player screen's mark row reads it

name: position_2
purpose: the position code too: written first, then copied to +6

name: tactics
purpose: a Pascal set of tactic bits; the player screen's tactics panel reads bits 1..4 and 5..8

name: squad
purpose: the 20 player indices (into the player array) of the country's squad

name: continent_rank
purpose: rank in its continent, one of the three rating inputs

name: world_rank
purpose: world rank, one of the three rating inputs

name: continent
purpose: the continent, one of the three rating inputs

name: team_tactics
purpose: R008, the team tactics bits; bit 8 picks the player screen's mark text

name: manager
purpose: 0x80 + the manager's number when a human manages the country
